summary: Facts module output stays in memory, while most other modules need register to reuse output; run the network playbook with ansible-playbook -i vyos.example.net, -u ansible -k -e ansible_network_os=vyos.vyos.vyos first_playbook.yml.
questions: How do I run a network playbook against a single device?
